description:
Each comment is inserted as it is written, without a staging step. "The overlay" is ".image-comment-overlay"; "the frame" is ".image-comment-overlay .image-comment-frame" (it shrink-wraps the image, so its box is the image's displayed pixels and a fraction of it is a fraction of the image). "Drag from (a, b) to (c, d)" means: move the mouse over the frame at offsets (a × its width, b × its height) from its top-left, press the left button, move to (c × width, d × height) in N steps (5 unless said otherwise), and release; read the frame's box with getBoundingClientRect when computing the offsets. "Drag the middle half" is a drag from (0.25, 0.25) to (0.75, 0.75). The open comment dialog has its title ".diff-viewer-comment-dialog-handle" (it names the region being commented on), its input ".diff-viewer-comment-input" and its button "Add Comment" (name exactly that). window.geometry() returns the WxH+X+Y region the dialog title names; window.middleHalf(W, H) returns "ok" if that region is the middle half of a WxH image, within tolerance, and otherwise what is off; window.keepGeometry() keeps the current geometry for later, and window.kept(i) returns the i-th one kept (from 0). Check the message input's (data-testid "message-input") value with an eval comparing it to the exact string, building it with window.kept(i) where it says G or Gi; 
 is a newline. Perform the steps in order.
1. Navigate to /c/inline. Wait (up to 30s) for the image ".markdown-content img[src*="shelley-inline-image-demo.png"]" to be visible. Click it. The overlay should be visible, and its ".image-comment-hint" should contain "Drag a box".
2. Three regions in a row. Each one's comment appends to the message input as soon as it is written, so the composer is up to date throughout rather than at the end. For each (i, text, drag) of (0, "top left", from (0.05, 0.05) to (0.3, 0.3)), (1, "middle", from (0.4, 0.4) to (0.6, 0.6)), (2, "bottom right", from (0.7, 0.7) to (0.95, 0.95)), in order: make the drag in 8 steps; keep the geometry (Gi) once the dialog shows it (window.geometry() non-empty); fill the dialog's input with the text; click "Add Comment"; the message input's value should then be exactly the comments so far, each "> image shelley-inline-image-demo.png [region Gi of 48x48]
<text>

", concatenated in order; every commented region stays drawn and numbered in order: there should be exactly i + 1 ".image-comment-overlay .image-comment-region", and the (i+1)-th ".image-comment-overlay .image-comment-region-badge" should have text exactly i + 1.
3. Focus must not follow the injected text into the composer behind the still-open view, or the next keystroke would go to the wrong place: the message input must not be focused, and ".image-comment-overlay .image-comment-container" should be (document.activeElement).
4. A whole-image comment appends the same way and draws no region: click the overlay's button "Comment on the whole image", fill the dialog's input with "and overall" and click "Add Comment". The message input's value should be exactly the three region comments followed by "> image shelley-inline-image-demo.png [whole image, 48x48]
and overall

". There should still be exactly 3 regions, and the overlay's ".image-comment-sent" should contain "4 comments added".
5. Only closing dismisses the view: click the overlay's button "Close image comments". The overlay should be gone (count 0), and the message input's value unchanged (exactly the four comments).
